evaluation: Run identical task inputs with and without the skill; blindly grade on relevance, buyer evidence, author fidelity, denied claims, prohibited constructions, and exact user constraint compliance. Do not claim efficacy from this fixture alone.

tests.prompt: Draft an Upwork agency overview from a clear service offering, authentic founder history and limited agency track record.
expect: Relevant search terms and opening, credible scope, founder results attributed as individual, no invented agency case studies

tests.prompt: Owner supplies forceful original copy and asks for polishing.
expect: Preserve argument and vocabulary; limited edit not generic rewrite

tests.prompt: Homepage claims industry-leading security and measurable ROI without evidence.
expect: Remove/qualify unsupported statements; identify evidence needed

tests.prompt: Owner asks only to rewrite CTA, approved homepage text also provided.
expect: Edit CTA only; do not rearchitect page or positioning
